innate.name: Fast independent judgment among equals
innate.behavior: In a discussion, you read the situation and commit to a position before others finish qualifying theirs. When a plan lands on the table, you already know which part you would run and say so plainly. Among peers — classmates, teammates, co-founders — you naturally become the one whose read gets adopted, not because you lobby for it but because you speak first and with certainty. If someone challenges you, you hold your line and re-check later, rather than pausing to re-check before answering.
innate.evidence: Companion is the heaviest force in this chart, with Rob Wealth nearly equal behind it: the year, month and day stems are all Gui water, the hour stem is Ren, and the month, day and hour branches — Hai, Hai, Zi — are water, while the year branch Ro holds the only wood. Water runs one current through almost the whole chart, so judgment formed inside your own head, confirmed by peers who mirror it, is the default mode. Officer and Killings weigh nothing, so no external authority-shaped force ever built the habit of seeking approval before deciding.

innate.name: Craft-level output when you actually enjoy the work
innate.behavior: Given a task you find intrinsically interesting — writing, cooking, building something with your hands, tuning a process — you go quiet, work long hours without noticing, and produce something polished. You do it for the feel of doing it well, not for the review. Others notice the quality before you mention it. But this mode only switches on when the task itself pleases you; the same effort on assigned work you find dull barely starts.
innate.evidence: Eating God is the one real outlet in the chart — the hidden Yi wood in the year branch Ro — and a small thread of Hurting Officer sits in the hidden Jia of the two Hai branches. Output is the only channel through which the enormous water volume can leave as visible work, and Eating God specifically is the craftsman's outlet: slow, self-pleasing, detail-oriented production rather than performance for a crowd. The outlet is narrow relative to the water behind it, which is why the enjoyment condition decides whether anything ships.

trained.name: Out-competing peers for the same room
trained.behavior: When resources are scarce and shared — one promotion slot, one client, one grant — you move faster and harder than people expect, sometimes taking what a colleague assumed was theirs. You can hold your own in a scramble, claim credit in a meeting, and not feel guilt about it in the moment. It works, and it wins rounds. But it also means your closest relationships sit on the same ground you compete for.
trained.evidence: Rob Wealth runs almost as heavy as Companion here — the hour stem is Ren, and the hidden Ren inside both Hai branches adds more of it — so the peer field this chart lives in is not only cooperative but crowded with rivals for the same resources. Wealth weighs zero, meaning the pie itself is thin in the structure; when peers and rivals outweigh everything else, the trained reflex is to fight harder for shares rather than to grow the pie. The early luck stretches amplify this: the pillars beginning around ages nine, nineteen and twenty-nine add more water and metal to a chart already saturated, extending the peer-dense environment for decades.
trained.trained_by: A peer-saturated environment with thin external resources: many capable people your age around you, competing for limited slots, with no adult or institution strong enough to allocate rewards by rule.

trained.name: Self-reliant operation without external structure
trained.behavior: You set your own schedule, your own standards, your own definition of done. Handed a vague assignment, you interpret it yourself and start, rather than asking for specs. Working alone for long stretches does not bother you. The gap shows at the finish line: without a boss, client or contract imposing a deadline and acceptance criteria, projects drift — you keep refining or move to the next interesting thing, and the deliverable never gets forced out the door.
trained.evidence: Officer, Killings and Resource all weigh zero in this chart, and fire and earth count zero among the visible characters. Those are exactly the forces that represent rules, enforcement and institutional backing. With none of them present, no internal habit of answering to an outside standard was ever built into the structure — the engine marks this as a follow-the-strong configuration, one water current with no banks. The pillars starting around ages forty-nine and fifty-nine (Wu over Wu, then Ding over Si) are the first sustained stretches of earth and fire — the first decades where the environment itself supplies structure and demand rather than peers.
trained.trained_by: Growing up with abundant peer mirroring and absent external demand: nobody required proof, contracts or filed results from you, so you learned to run entirely on your own judgment.

defensive.name: Reading the room and matching it before anyone asks
defensive.looks_like: Outsiders see social smoothness: you fit into any group quickly, pick up its language and rhythm, and people describe you as easy to be around. It reads as interpersonal skill.
defensive.evidence: Companion and Rob Wealth together outweigh everything else combined — water fills seven of the visible characters — while Wealth, the family that represents tangible results an outsider can hold, weighs zero. The defensive skill grows straight from that imbalance: the entire field of energy is peers, so the safest move the structure learned was synchrony, and the scarcest thing — banked, transferable output — is exactly what the reflex postpones.
defensive.actual_cost: The matching is surveillance, not ease. You track where the group's opinion is heading and adjust so you never stand exposed alone, and that continuous monitoring tires you without producing anything. After long social stretches you are drained rather than fed, because the effort went into staying aligned, not into making anything. The cost compounds: years spent circulating among capable people can end with little an outsider can point to as yours, since the chart's Wealth family — the one that banks results — carries no weight at all.

one_leverage: Keep the Eating God outlet — the craft mode — as your one lever. The chart's judgment and peer force are enormous but closed: water circulates among yourself and people like you, and nothing leaves. The hidden Yi wood in the year branch Ro is the single natural drain valve, the only place where that volume converts into a finished thing an outsider can see, hold or buy. Judgment without output stays private; output forces your judgment into a form the world can test and pay for. So the rule is simple: every time your own reading hardens into conviction among peers, attach a deliverable to it — a written piece, a working prototype, a signed thing — before the next round of discussion begins. In the stretches beginning around age forty-nine and fifty-nine, earth and fire finally run strong in the luck sequence, and external structure and demand appear; the person who arrives there with a shipping habit already in place meets those decades with something to hand over, while the person who arrives with only conversation meets them empty-handed.
